description: This file contains a Java test class 'Test2ParseJsonPayloadToDitto' that sets up a benchmarking scenario for parsing JSON payloads and mapping them to Ditto protocol messages using JavaScript-based message mappers. It defines static JSON strings and JavaScript mapping scripts, creates external messages with unique correlation IDs, and provides methods to retrieve configured message mappers and external messages.

classes.name: Test2ParseJsonPayloadToDitto
classes.description: A benchmarking test class implementing MapToDittoProtocolScenario that prepares JSON payloads and JavaScript mapping scripts to test JSON parsing and message mapping to the Ditto protocol.

methods.name: getMessageMapper
methods.description: Returns a configured JavaScript message mapper using Rhino engine with the specified mapping script.

methods.name: getExternalMessage
methods.description: Provides the externally created message with JSON payload and headers for testing.
